messages.author: 3286fc25c6432b38
messages.subject: renameToUpperCaseExt
parts:
Hi Henrik,

I was re-running quantile normalization on some 250K Nsp data to
reproduce some results from a few months ago. After I did the initial
analysis (a few months ago) I deleted the probeData/[project_name],QN/
folder to save space. When I set up the project folder in rawData/, I
gave the raw data files .cel extensions (instead of .CEL). Now I'm
getting error messages because in
normalizeQuantile.AffymetrixCelFile,

> filename <- basename(getPathname(this))

gives me the filename with the .cel extension but

> createFrom(this, filename = pathname, path = NULL, verbose = less(verbose))

sets up a new file with a .CEL extension. Then when

> updateCel(pathname, intensities = x)

is called, 'pathname' points to the new file with the original .cel,
but that file doesn't exist. So updateCel complains.

Error in updateCel(pathname, intensities = x) :
Cannot update CEL file. File not found: probeData/trProject,QN/
Mapping250K_Nsp/tr_6_pa,XY.cel

When I modified AffymetrixCelFile.normalizeQuantile.R as follows, it
seemed to work:
...
# - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- - - -
# Generating output pathname
# - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- - - -
filename <- basename(getPathname(this));
pathname <- Arguments$getWritablePathname(filename, path=path,
mustNotExist=(!overwrite && !
skip));

pathname <- AffymetrixFile$renameToUpperCaseExt(pathname); ## Added
line here
...

Cheers,

Jeremy

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] renameToUpperCaseExt
parts:
Hi,

again, good spotting. For aroma.affymetrix v0.5.6 [2007-08-10] I did
the following:

o Now all generated CEL files are written with upper-case filename
extension (*.CEL). The main reason for this is that some other
software don't recognize CEL files with lower-case extension (*.cel).
Existing CEL files that are in lower case (*.cel) and that are
generated by the package are renamed to upper case (*.CEL).
Same thing for generated CDF files.

This is probably why you get the error. I'll include you bug fix.
Thanks. You could also solve it by renaming all your *.cel files to
*.CEL files.

Cheers

Henrik
